name: comp-582

frames.best_why: The language dropdown is open with all five codes listed and En checked.

tagline: Icon-only nav bar with hover tooltips, a theme switch and a language picker.
summary: A compact dark header holding a logo, four unlabelled icon links that name themselves on hover, a light/dark toggle, a globe language dropdown and a user avatar.
appearance: A dark header bar with a starburst logo, four small icon links, a sun toggle, a globe pill reading En and a round avatar. A thin divider runs under the bar, and hovering an icon reveals a small light tooltip.
behaviour: Hovering a nav icon pops a tooltip with its name and the sun icon switches the theme. The globe button opens a dropdown of language codes (En, Es, Fr, De, Ja); choosing one updates the trigger label and closes the list.
demo_content: The four nav icons stand for Dashboard, Projects, Documentation and Team; languages are En, Es, Fr, De and Ja.
use_when: An app header needs compact icon navigation plus a language picker and theme switch.
avoid_when: Nav links and language options are hardcoded, and the icon-only desktop bar depends on hover tooltips to be understood.
customise: Nav labels, icons, active item and the five language codes are written in the file; colours come from theme tokens.
weight_why: A handful of icon links, one tooltip and a single select.

a11y.note: Every control is labelled, but there is no reduced-motion handling and meaning depends on icon tooltips.

polish_why: Crisp icon bar with working tooltips and a language picker; muted text is a little low contrast.
